OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages

          minimum: 400

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.

          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

## Summary

Implemented `registrationDate` on the owner-create flow: when omitted, it defaults to the server's current date; when supplied it's kept, and it's returned in ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `registrationDate` property (`type: string, format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Since `Owner` is `allOf` `OwnerFields`, this generates a `LocalDate registrationDate` in both `OwnerFieldsDto` (request) and `OwnerDto` (response); Jackson serializes `LocalDate` as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — Added a `registrationDate` `LocalDate` field mapped to the `registration_date` column, with getter/setter. MapStruct maps it by name automatically in both directions.

3. **New function `DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate`** — Sets `registrationDate` to `LocalDate.now()` only when the mapped entity has none. Wired into `owners.POST.yml` as a governed step between `build` and `save` (a supplied date passes through untouched).

4. **DB schemas** — Added `registration_date DATE` to the owners table in all four dialects (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres). Fixed the hsqldb `data.sql` seed inserts (which used implicit column lists) by appending a `NULL` for the new column; the other dialects use explicit column lists and needed no change.

**Tests:** `AcceptanceTest.coreDefaultsToToday` and `functionalityKeepsSuppliedDate` both pass; full `mvn test` → BUILD SUCCESS (2/2, 0 failures).

One note on scope: the update path (`PUT /owners/{ownerId}`, via `ApplyOwner`) does not modify `registrationDate`, so an existing owner's registration date is preserved on update — consistent with the create-time semantics in the spec.
